TRI Reel Style Guide

Every reel starts on Energy v3. Tap a photo to see a real frame from your reels, add the styles you want on top, then copy the prompt and paste it into Claude with your Drive link.

Proven photo = real frame from your reels (tap to enlarge) Ready drawing only, not used in a reel yet New not built yet

Pick your reel type

One tap picks a tested set of styles. You can change any of them after.

Rules every prompt includes: your face is never covered, text stays inside Instagram and LinkedIn safe zones, your own voice is kept, and Claude shows you the full storyboard to approve before rendering. Use one Showpiece effect per reel at most. Styles marked "plain wall" need a plain, light background behind you. Some style ideas build on public creator style packs by @brand.nat and @meghanachandani_.
